locator: Questions13 and15, PDF pp.34 and40; Section3
statement: Under suitable nondegenerate iid passage-time assumptions, prove a fluctuation exponent strictly below1/2, identify the planar exponent as1/3, and establish a positive exponent in a suitable dimension.
statement_caveat: These closely related exponent-range targets are grouped. Different definitions using variances or stronger concentration must be specified before claiming equivalence.
title: Subdiffusive and KPZ passage-time fluctuation exponents
